subject: Post-call: NovaForge trial traffic & success plan
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@novaforge.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-08T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: NovaForge trial traffic & success plan

Hi Emily — thanks again for the call earlier. Short recap + next steps so we have clear owners for the trial. I pasted the lightweight intake we discussed below and flagged open items. Happy to jump on a 30m technical kickoff if that helps.

Quick recap of what you described (please correct me if I missed anything):
- Primary use: customer support assistant that augments agent replies. Requests are mostly single-turn generation with a smaller chat history path for escalations.
- Average prompt size today: ~380 tokens (template + context). Typical model invocation returns ~120 tokens on average.
- Request mix: ~85% single-turn, ~15% multi-turn (2–6 turns).
- Expected steady-state RPS: 40–60 RPS over office hours (US PST) with peaks up to ~220 RPS during flash sale windows (5–8 minute bursts).
- Typical concurrency target: 40 concurrent streams; concurrency during bursts can spike to ~150 for ~5–8 minutes.
- 95th token length (total request+response): ~700 tokens; 99th ~1,400 tokens due to large transcripts.
- SLA goals: p95 latency <= 250ms for single-turn generations (soft), error rate < 0.5%.

Proposed trial success criteria (draft):
- Functional: Redwood serves sample traffic at target concurrency with error rate < 0.5% for a 48-hour sustained window at 60 RPS.
- Performance: p95 end-to-end latency for single-turn generation < 300ms across the trial (allowing one warmup day).
- Cost/readout: estimate token cost per million for your workload and a 10% improvement action (caching/quantization) identified.
- Stability: no unplanned fallbacks for more than 10 minutes combined over the trial period.

Immediate next steps + owners:
- Jordan (me): Deliver trial playbook + workload probe script (attached). Target: today EOD.
- Grace (Infra): Validate capacity profile and propose Dedicated/Hosted config for test. Target: 2 business days.
- Aditya (Solutions): Build success metrics dashboard (latency, errors, tokens/RPS) and coordinate evaluation queries. Target: 3 business days.

Open items for NovaForge to provide:
1) Representative traffic sample (1000 sample requests in JSONL) — include prompt templates and distributions across single vs multi-turn.
2) Spike window windows calendar (approx times of flash sales over next 30 days).
3) Confirmation of which customer data needs to be redacted/encrypted (PII fields).
4) VPN or S3 access for workload probe upload; or confirm Drive link works.

Attachments: novaforge_poc_playbook_v1.pdf (playbook), workload_probe_script.yaml (load probe & collector).

If that reads correctly, I’ll attach the playbook and proposed timeline and we can book the kickoff.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192

--

From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@novaforge.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-08T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: NovaForge trial traffic & success plan

Thanks Jordan — this is a good summary, appreciate the clarity. A couple quick clarifications:
- The 220 RPS peak is accurate but typically only lasts 4–6 minutes and happens twice a week.
- The 99th token length is closer to 1,200 for us (we had a worst-case export that was artificially long).
- For PII: customer email/names must be redacted; conversation IDs can stay. We can supply a sanitized sample.

We’ll get the 1k sample JSONL and the spike calendar to you by Monday. For access, Drive link is easiest for us (we’ll drop files in a shared folder).

We also want to prioritize a check on cold-start behavior for the multi-turn flows — during a sudden spike we’ve seen higher latencies for sessions that haven’t been warmed. Can Grace validate cache/KV behavior in the playbook?

Happy to do a kickoff on Tuesday 7/13 11am PT if that works for your team.

Thanks — Emily
Emily Carter
Head of ML Ops | NovaForge
emily.carter@novaforge.com

--

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-08T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: NovaForge trial traffic & success plan

Forwarding Emily's clarifications. Action items for infra & solutions below — these are time-sensitive because they want a Tuesday kickoff.

Grace — can you run a quick capacity sketch for both Hosted (autoscale profile) and a minimal Dedicated footprint that meets: sustained 60 RPS, burst headroom to 220 RPS (5–10m), and p95 < 300ms single-turn. Also include KV/prefix caching recommendations to improve cold-starts on multi-turn flows.

Aditya — please draft the initial dashboard queries (p50/p95 latency, token consumption, errors by endpoint, warm vs cold session latencies) and a short list of acceptance tests we can automate post-deploy (smoke-run, burst replay, long-conversation stability). We’ll want those wired to our trial readout doc.

Target dates:
- Grace capacity sketch: 2 business days (2027-07-10 COB)
- Aditya dashboard + acceptance tests: 3 business days (2027-07-11 COB)
- Jordan to finalize playbook and upload artifacts: today 7/08 COB (in progress)

If anything looks like it will slip, flag it and we’ll rejigger the kickoff.

-Jordan

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-09T07:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call: NovaForge trial traffic & success plan

Quick update from infra: initial capacity sketch attached (high level) — recommending a small Dedicated pool with auto-burst into Hosted (hybrid routing) for the flash sale windows. Notes:
- Baseline nodes: 4 x A100-class (sustained 60 RPS at median prompt sizes if quantized to 4-bit; we’ll provide more precise token-per-second numbers once we run the probe).
- Burst profile: autoscale to 12 nodes for 220 RPS short windows (5–10m), with a warm-cache pre-warming job that can be triggered 2 minutes before predicted spikes.
- KV cache behavior: multi-turn cold sessions add ~120–180ms; with prefix caching it drops to ~30–50ms. Will add recommended TTLs and cache warmers to the playbook.

Deliverables: capacity sketch PDF (attached) and a small checklist for pre-kickoff smoke tests. I’ll link the precise perf numbers after we run the workload probe tomorrow.

- Grace

Attachments: novaforge_capacity_sketch.pdf

From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@novaforge.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: NovaForge Trial Team <trial@novaforge.com>
Date: 2027-07-09T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: NovaForge trial traffic & success plan

Perfect — Tuesday 7/13 11am PT works for us. We’ll drop the sanitized 1k JSONL and spike calendar into the Drive link by Monday morning.

One ask before kickoff: can you include an explicit acceptance checklist we can sign off on at the end of the trial (I don’t need legal-level detail, just clear pass/fail criteria we can sign).

Thanks — Emily
